title: Demagetus
summary: Raleigh names Demagetus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Demagetus, who raigned in the Ile of Rhodes, and by an Oracle tooke to wife a daughter of Aristomenes. Her name is not printed. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXVII, §. IV, sig. 366b
